### 2. West Side PICO - 5yr Post Burn
Trees
```{r}
#Load data and (1) calculate basal area, (2) group trees/poles
trees <- read.csv("2026 Annual Report Data/Clean/PICO_trees_data.csv") %>%
dplyr::select(2,3,5,7:14) %>%mutate(TreeBA_ft2 = (pi*(DBH/200)^2)*10.7639, PlotArea_Acres = 0.079) %>% 
  mutate(BurnedStatus = case_when(Plot == "PICO_08" ~ "unburned", Plot == "PICO_09" ~ "unburned",Plot == "PICO_10" ~ "burned",Plot == "PICO_11" ~ "burned",
      Plot == "PICO_12" ~ "burned",Plot == "PICO_13" ~ "burned",Plot == "PICO_14" ~ "burned",Plot == "PICO_15" ~ "unburned",Plot == "PICO_16" ~ "burned",Plot ==
        "PICO_19" ~ "unburned",Plot == "PICO_20" ~ "burned",Plot == "PICO_21" ~ "unburned",Plot == "PICO_24" ~ "unburned",Plot == "PICO_25" ~ "unburned",TRUE ~ NA_character_))%>%mutate(Size = if_else(DBH>=15,"Overstory","Pole")) 
  
#Basal Area figure
plot_ba <- trees %>% filter(!is.na(TreeBA_ft2)) %>% group_by(Plot, Status, Species, BurnedStatus) %>% 
  summarise(BA_sqft_acre = sum(TreeBA_ft2)/first(PlotArea_Acres), .groups="drop") 
plot_ba1 <- plot_ba %>% group_by(Status, Species, BurnedStatus) %>% summarise(mean = mean(BA_sqft_acre), sd = sd(BA_sqft_acre), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(plot_ba1, aes(x = Species,y =  mean, fill=Status)) +
  geom_col(position=position_dodge(width = 0.9)) + geom_errorbar(aes(ymin= mean - sd, ymax = mean+sd), width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.9))+
  scale_fill_manual(values=nps_pal) +
  facet_wrap(~BurnedStatus) + labs(title = "Figure 1A: Basal Area", y = "sq ft per acre")+  theme_nps()

#Stats - Species + Live/Dead
#Stats
model <- glm(BA_sqft_acre ~ BurnedStatus * Species * Status, family = poisson, data = plot_ba)
deviance(model) / df.residual(model) #if > ~ 1.5, use negative binomial
library(MASS)
model <- glm.nb(BA_sqft_acre ~ BurnedStatus * Species * Status, data = plot_ba)
library(emmeans)
emmeans(model, pairwise ~ BurnedStatus | Species | Status)
#significantly more dead pico in burned v unburned (p = 0.0008)


#stats2
ba_stats <- plot_ba %>% pivot_wider(names_from = c(Species, Status), values_from = BA_sqft_acre)
ba_stats[is.na(ba_stats)] <- 0
ba_mat <- ba_stats %>% dplyr::select(PICO_D:PIEN_D)
adonis2(ba_mat ~ BurnedStatus,
        data = ba_stats,
        permutations = 999,
        method = "euclidean")
#Yes there is a significant difference in basal area between burned and unburned plots (PERMANOVA, p = 0.001, F = 14.702)
wilcox.test(PICO_D ~ BurnedStatus, data = ba_stats) #significant difference in dead pico

# ==============================================================================

# DBH
plot_dbh <- trees %>% filter(!is.na(DBH)) %>% group_by(Plot, Status, Species, BurnedStatus, Size) %>% summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") 
plot_dbh1 <- plot_dbh %>% group_by(Status, BurnedStatus, Size) %>% summarise(mean = mean(count), sd = sd(count), .drop = "groups")

ggplot(plot_dbh1, aes(Size, mean, fill = Status)) + geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) + geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean-sd, ymax = mean+sd), width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.9))  + scale_fill_manual(values=nps_pal) +facet_wrap(~BurnedStatus)+ labs(title = "Figure 1B: Size distribution", y = "Count")+  theme_nps()

dbh_mean <- plot_dbh %>% group_by(BurnedStatus, Size , Status) %>% summarise(count = sum(count), .groups = "drop")


#Stats
model <- glm(count ~ BurnedStatus * Size *Status, family = poisson, data = plot_dbh)
deviance(model) / df.residual(model) #if > ~ 1.5, use negative binomial
library(MASS)
model <- glm.nb(count ~ BurnedStatus * Size*Status, data = plot_dbh)
library(emmeans)
emmeans(model, pairwise ~ BurnedStatus | Size | Status)
#difference in poles but not overstory between burned and unburned

# ==============================================================================

# Height summaries
height <- trees %>%  filter(!is.na(Height)) %>% group_by(Species, Status, BurnedStatus) %>%summarise(meanHt=mean(Height), sdHt=sd(Height), maxHt=max(Height), .groups="drop") 
height2 <- trees %>%  filter(!is.na(Height)) %>% group_by(Species, Status) %>%summarise(meanHt=mean(Height), sdHt=sd(Height), maxHt=max(Height), .groups="drop") 

ggplot(height, aes(Species, meanHt, fill=Status)) +
geom_col(position=position_dodge()) + facet_wrap(~BurnedStatus) + scale_fill_manual(values = nps_pal) +
```

```{r}
##*** Do Stats
#Format dataframe for statistical analyses
fuels_stats <- fuels %>% dplyr::select(-c(X, Burned2020)) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = FuelCategory, values_from = value)
fuels_stats$BurnedStatus <- factor(fuels_stats$BurnedStatus, levels = c("burned", "unburned"))
# library(vegan)

fuel_mat <- fuels_stats %>%dplyr::select(OneHr: TotalAll)

adonis2(fuel_mat ~ BurnedStatus,
        data = fuels_stats,
        permutations = 999,
        method = "euclidean")

fuels_log <- fuels_stats %>%mutate(across(OneHr:TotalAll, log1p))
fuel_mat_log <- fuels_log %>% dplyr::select(OneHr: TotalAll)

adonis2(fuel_mat_log ~ BurnedStatus,
        data = fuels_log,
        permutations = 999,
        method = "euclidean")
#*log-transformed data shows significantly lower fuel loads in burned vs unburned (Log-Transormed PERMANOVA)

#univariate test
fuels2 <- read.csv("2026 Annual Report Data/Clean/PICO_fuels_report.csv")
fuels_sum <- fuels %>% group_by(Burned2020, FuelCategory) %>% summarise(mean = mean(value))

wilcox.test(OneHr ~ Burned2020, data = fuels2) # p = 0.002
wilcox.test(TenHr ~ Burned2020, data = fuels2) # p = 0.004
wilcox.test(HunHr ~ Burned2020, data = fuels2) # p = 0.04
wilcox.test(FineWood ~ Burned2020, data = fuels2) # p = 0.01
wilcox.test(ThoHr_Snd ~ Burned2020, data = fuels2)
wilcox.test(ThoHr_Rot ~ Burned2020, data = fuels2)
wilcox.test(TotalWood ~ Burned2020, data = fuels2)
wilcox.test(Duff ~ Burned2020, data = fuels2) #p = 0.002
wilcox.test(Litter ~ Burned2020, data = fuels2)#p = 0.002
wilcox.test(TotalAll ~ Burned2020, data = fuels2) #p = 0.13
wilcox.test(DuffDep ~ Burned2020, data = fuels2) # p = o.002
wilcox.test(LittDep ~ Burned2020, data = fuels2) # p = 0.002
wilcox.test(TotDep ~ Burned2020, data = fuels2) # 0.002

# Table with results
fuel_categories <- c("OneHr", "TenHr", "HunHr", "FineWood", "ThoHr_Snd", "ThoHr_Rot", "TotalWood", "Duff", "Litter", "TotalAll", "DuffDep", "LittDep", "TotDep")

wilcox_results <- lapply(fuel_categories, function(cat){
  test <- wilcox.test(as.formula(paste(cat, "~ Burned2020")), data = fuels2)
  data.frame(FuelCategory = cat, W = test$statistic, p_value = test$p.value)
})

wilcox_results <- bind_rows(wilcox_results)
wilcox_results <- wilcox_results %>% mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"))
wilcox_results <- wilcox_results %>% mutate(W = round(W, 2), p_value = round(p_value, 3), p_adj = round(p_adj, 3))
table <- wilcox_results %>% gt() %>% tab_header(title = "Table 1: Wilcoxon Test Results - Burned vs. Unburned Plots") %>%
  cols_label(FuelCategory = "Fuel Category", W = "W Statistic", p_value = "Raw p-value", p_adj = "Adjusted p-value") %>%
  fmt_number(columns = vars(W, p_value, p_adj), decimals = 3) %>% 
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"), locations = cells_body(columns = vars(FuelCategory), rows = p_adj < 0.05))
```

Seedlings
```{r}


seedling <- read.csv("2026 Annual Report Data/Clean/PICO_seedling_data.csv") %>%
  group_by(Plot, Item.Code, Status, Height, Burned2020) %>%
  summarise(count = sum(Count), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(count = if_else(Plot %in% c("PICO_08", "PICO_15", "PICO_19", "PICO_21"), count * 2, count),
    seedlings_per_acre = count / 0.079)%>%mutate(BurnedStatus = case_when(Burned2020 == "yes" ~ "burned", Burned2020 == "no" ~ "unburned"))

##Height Histogram
# Make Height an ordered factor for proper sorting
seedling$Height <- factor(seedling$Height,levels = c("0.15", "0.3", "0.6", "1", "2", "3"),ordered = TRUE)
# Plot
ggplot(seedling, aes(x = Height, y = seedlings_per_acre, fill = BurnedStatus)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", alpha = 0.85,position=position_dodge(width = 0.9) ) +scale_fill_manual(values = nps_pal) +
  facet_wrap(~Item.Code, scales="free_y") + labs(title = "Figure 3: Seedling Height Distribution",x = "Height Class (m)",
    y = "seedling density (seedlings per acre)",fill = "Burn Status") + theme_nps() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
# ==============================================================================
#STATS - PERMANOVA

seedl_stats <- seedling %>% group_by(Plot, Item.Code, Height, Burned2020) %>% summarise(count = sum(count), .groups = "drop") %>% pivot_wider(names_from = c(Item.Code, Height), values_from = count, values_fill = 0)
seedl_stats$Burned2020 <- factor(seedl_stats$Burned2020, levels = c("no", "yes"))

#Calculate distance matrix and run permanova
seedl_matrix <- as.matrix(seedl_stats[, c(3:24)])
dist_matrix <- vegdist(seedl_matrix, method = "bray")

adonis2(dist_matrix ~ Burned2020, data = seedl_stats, permutations = 999)
#siginificant: p = 0.003
#validate
disp <- betadisper(dist_matrix, seedl_stats$Burned2020) # p > .05 so I am good
anova(disp)

######################
#ordinal model for PICO
pico_dat <- seedling %>% mutate(Height = factor(Height, ordered = TRUE), Burned2020 = factor(Burned2020, levels = c("no", "yes")))

mod <- polr(Height ~ Burned2020, weights = count, data = pico_dat, Hess = TRUE)
summary(mod)

exp(coef(mod))


#p value
(ctable <- coef(summary(mod)))
pvals <- pnorm(abs(ctable[, "t value"]), lower.tail = FALSE) * 2
cbind(ctable, "p value" = pvals)


library(emmeans)

emm <- emmeans(mod, ~ Burned2020, mode = "prob")
plot(emm)


#####################


#look at means for pico
pico_means <- pico %>% mutate(weightedheight = count * Height) %>% group_by(Plot, Burned2020) %>% summarise(mean_height = sum(weightedheight)/sum(count), .groups = "drop")
means2 <- pico_means %>% group_by(Burned2020) %>% summarise(mean = mean(mean_height))
t.test(mean_height ~ Burned2020, data = pico_means)
```

Cover
```{r}

#load data and add functional groups / species names
cover <- read.csv("2026 Annual Report Data/Clean/PICO_cover_data.csv")%>%dplyr::select(-X) %>% 
   mutate(Species = trimws(Species),Species = if_else(Species == "BERBE", "MARE11", Species),
    FuncGroup = case_when(
      Species %in% c("PICO", "PIEN", "ABLA" ) ~ "Tree",
      Species %in% c("ROWO", "MARE11", "JUCO6", "RUDE") ~ "Shrub",
      Species %in% c("CAXX2", "BRINI", "AGSC5", "TRSP2") ~ "Grass",
      Species %in% c("VAMY2", "VASC", "ORPA3", "CHANC", "HIAL2", "GARA2", "TAOF", "CAPA10", "GNDE", "EPAN2", "SEWO", "SYSPS", "ACMI2", "LIBO3", "ORSE") ~ "Forb",
      Species %in% c("LITT1", "WOOD1", "ROCK1", "BARE1") ~ "Substrate",TRUE ~ "Other")) %>% 
  mutate(Native = case_when(Species %in% c("BRINI", "TAOF") ~ "non-native", TRUE ~ "native")) %>% mutate(SpeciesName = case_when(Species == "ABLA" ~ "Abies lasiocarpa",Species == "ACMI2" ~ "Achillea millefolium",Species == "AGSC5" ~ "Agrostis scabra", #rough bentgrass, 
                                                        Species == "BRINI" ~ "Bromus inermis",
                                                        Species == "CAPA10"~ "Campanula parryi", #parry's bellflower
                                                        Species == "CAXX2" ~ "Carex",
                                                        Species == "CHANC" ~ "Chamerion angustifolium", #fireweed
                                                        Species == "EPAN2" ~ "Epilobium angustifolium", #fireweed
                                                        Species == "GARA2" ~ "Gayophytum ramosissimum", #pinyon groundsmoke
                                                        Species == "GNDE" ~ "Pseudognaphalium macounii", #Macoun's cudweed
                                                        Species == "HIAL2" ~ "Hieracium albiflorum", #white hawkweed
                                                        Species == "JUCO6" ~ "Common juniper",
                                                        Species == "LIBO3" ~ "Linnaea borealis", #twinflower
                                                        Species == "MARE11"~ "Mahonia repens",
                                                        Species == "ORPA3" ~ "Oreochrysum parryi", #parry's goldenrod
                                                        Species == "ORSE" ~ "Orthilia secunda", #wintergreen
                                                        Species == "PICO" ~ "Pinus contorta",
                                                        Species == "PIEN" ~ "Picea engelmannii",
                                                        Species == "ROWO" ~ "Rosa woodsii",
                                                        Species == "RUDE" ~ "Rubus deliciousus",
                                                        Species == "SEWO" ~ "Senecio wootonii", #wooton's ragwort
                                                        Species == "SYSPS" ~ "Symphyotrichum spathulatum", #western mountain aster
                                                        Species == "TAOF" ~ "Taraxacum officinale",
                                                        Species == "TRSP2" ~ "Trisetum spicatum",
                                                        Species == "VAMY2" ~ "Vaccinium myrtillus",
                                                        Species == "VASC" ~ "Vaccinium scoparium"))

# Functional Group plot

fun_cover <- cover %>% group_by(Plot, FuncGroup, Burned2020) %>% summarise(points=n(), .groups="drop") %>%mutate(percent_cover=points/40*100) %>% filter(FuncGroup!= "Substrate")
fun_cover$Burned2020 <- factor(fun_cover$Burned2020, levels = c("no", "yes"))

ggplot(fun_cover, aes(FuncGroup, percent_cover, fill=FuncGroup)) +
geom_boxplot(alpha=0.8) + facet_wrap(~Burned2020, labeller = labeller(Burned2020 = as_labeller(burn_labels))) +
scale_fill_manual(values=nps_pal) +
labs(title="Figure 4A: Understory Cover by Functional Group", y="Percent Cover", x="Functional Group") +
theme_nps() +
theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45,hjust=1))

# species plot
cover$SpeciesName <- factor(cover$SpeciesName, levels = c("Achillea millefolium", "Campanula parryi", "Chamerion angustifolium", "Epilobium angustifolium", "Gayophytum ramosissimum", "Pseudognaphalium macounii", "Hieracium albiflorum", "Linnaea borealis", "Oreochrysum parryi", "Orthilia secunda", "Senecio wootonii", "Symphyotrichum spathulatum", "Taraxacum officinale", "Vaccinium myrtillus", "Vaccinium scoparium", "Agrostis scabra", "Bromus inermis", "Carex", "Trisetum spicatum", "Common juniper", "Mahonia repens", "Rosa woodsii", "Rubus deliciousus", "Abies lasiocarpa", "Pinus contorta", "Picea engelmannii"), ordered = TRUE)
  
sp_cover <- cover %>% filter(FuncGroup!= "Substrate") %>% group_by(FuncGroup, Burned2020, SpeciesName) %>% summarise(points=n(), .groups="drop") %>% 
  filter(FuncGroup == "Forb" | FuncGroup == "Grass")
sp_cover$Burned2020 <- factor(sp_cover$Burned2020, levels = c("no", "yes"))

burn_labels <- c("no" = "Unburned", "yes" =  "Burned")

#bolden species names in graph that appear in both burned and unburned
species_both <- sp_cover %>%filter(FuncGroup %in% c("Forb", "Grass")) %>%  # filter to just these two FuncGroups
  group_by(SpeciesName) %>%summarise(n_burn_status = n_distinct(Burned2020), .groups = "drop") %>%filter(n_burn_status == 2) %>% pull(SpeciesName)

bold_species_labels <- function(x) {sapply(x, function(lbl) { 
  if (lbl %in% species_both) { paste0("**", lbl, "**")  } else {lbl}})}

ggplot(sp_cover, aes(x = SpeciesName, y = points, fill = FuncGroup)) + geom_col(position = position_dodge()) + facet_wrap(~Burned2020, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1, labeller = labeller(Burned2020 = as_labeller(burn_labels)))+scale_fill_manual(values=nps_pal) +labs(title="Figure 4B: Understory Species Distribution", y="Hits", x="Species") +theme_nps() + theme(axis.text.x = element_markdown(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) + scale_x_discrete(labels = bold_species_labels)


# ==============================================================================

# Stats for cover - PERMANOVA
cover_stats <- cover %>% group_by(Plot, Burned2020, FuncGroup) %>% summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% pivot_wider(names_from = FuncGroup, values_from = count, values_fill = 0)
cover_stats$Burned2020 <- factor(cover_stats$Burned2020, levels = c("no", "yes"))

#Calculate distance matrix and run PERMANOVA
cover_matrix <- as.matrix(cover_stats[, c("Forb", "Grass", "Shrub", "Tree")])
dist_matrix <- vegdist(cover_matrix, method = "bray")

adonis2(dist_matrix ~ Burned2020, data = cover_stats, permutations = 999)

#validate
disp <- betadisper(dist_matrix, cover_stats$Burned2020) # p > .05 so I am good
anova(disp)
plot(disp)


# text: Differences in understory functional group composiiton between burned and unburned plots were tested using permutational multivariate analysis of variance (PERMANOVA; Anderson, 2001) based on Bray-Curtis distances with 999 permutations. Analyses were performed in R (R Core Team) using the vegan package (Oksanan et al 2025). 

# Stats for species % cover  - ANOVA
cover_stats2 <- cover %>% group_by(Plot, Burned2020, FuncGroup, SpeciesName)%>% summarise(points=n(), .groups="drop")%>%mutate(percent_cover=points/40*100) %>% filter(FuncGroup!= "Substrate") %>% mutate(Burned2020 = factor(Burned2020, levels = c("yes", "no")))

#species
library(lmerTest)
model <- lmer(percent_cover ~ Burned2020 * SpeciesName + (1|Plot), data = cover_stats2)
anova(model)
emm <- emmeans(model, pairwise ~ Burned2020 | SpeciesName) #post-hoc
summary(emm)
#Oreochrysum parryi: 5.0 for burned and 7.5 for unburned. Bromus inermis: 5 for burned and 2.5 for unburned. carex: 10.42 for burned and 8.12 for unburned

#functional group
model <- lmer(percent_cover ~ Burned2020 * FuncGroup + (1|Plot), data = cover_stats2)
anova(model)
emm <- emmeans(model, pairwise ~ Burned2020 | FuncGroup) #post-hoc
summary(emm)

#significantly more forbs in burned plots
## text: interaction between burn and functional group was not statistically signifant (Burned x Functional Groups: F = 1.1392, p = 0.3377540). However, post-hoc comparisons revealed that forb abundance was significantly greater in burned plots than in unburned plots (p < 0.02), whereas no significant differences were detected in other functional groups.
```

Shrubs
```{r}


shrubs <- read.csv("2026 Annual Report Data/Clean/PICO_shrub_data.csv") %>%select(-X) %>%
mutate(Species = Item.Code, Area_acres=Tran..Area/4046.86)
#I have 1 40m2 and 1 36m2 belts per plot, so 76m2, and 76m2 = 0.01879, so I need to divide the count per plot by .01878 to get count per acre
shrub_density <- shrubs %>% group_by(Plot, Species, Burned2020) %>% summarise(Count = sum(Count), .groups = "drop") %>% mutate(Stems_per_acre = Count/0.01879)



shrub_density_tbl <- shrub_density %>%group_by(Species, Burned2020) %>%
summarise(count = sum(Count), mean_density=mean(Stems_per_acre), sd_density=sd(Stems_per_acre), .groups="drop") %>%
gt() %>%
```

```{r}
#Mixed Effects Model
fuels2 <- read.csv("2026 Annual Report Data/Clean/Spring25RX_fuels_report.csv") %>% select(-c(ThoHr_Snd, ThoHr_Rot))

fuels2$MonStatus <- factor(fuels2$MonStatus, levels = c("00PRE", "01POST", "01YR01"))

#log-transform
fuels2 <- fuels2 %>% mutate(OneHr = sqrt(OneHr), TenHr = sqrt(TenHr), HunHr = sqrt(HunHr), FineWood = sqrt(FineWood), TotalWood = sqrt(TotalWood), Duff = sqrt(Duff), Litter = sqrt(Litter), TotalAll = sqrt(TotalAll))
fuel_vars <- c("OneHr", "TenHr", "HunHr", "FineWood", "TotalWood", "Duff", "Litter", "TotalAll")

model <- lmer(TotalAlll ~ MonStatus + (1 | Macroplot), data = fuels2)
anova(model)
emmeans(model, pairwise ~ MonStatus, adjust = "BH")


#Putting all pairwise results into a table

pairwise_results <- map_dfr(fuel_vars, function(var) {
  m <- lmer(as.formula(paste0(var, " ~ MonStatus + (1 | Macroplot)")), data = fuels2)
  em <- emmeans(m, pairwise ~ MonStatus, adjust = "BH", type = "response")
   as.data.frame(em$contrasts) %>%
    mutate(FuelCategory = var) %>%
    select(FuelCategory, contrast, estimate, SE, df, t.ratio, p.value)})

pairwise_results <- pairwise_results %>% mutate(estimate = round(estimate, 2),SE = round(SE, 2),t.ratio = round(t.ratio, 2),p.value = round(p.value, 3))
pre_post <- pairwise_results %>% filter(contrast == "00PRE - 01POST")
post_yr <- pairwise_results %>% filter(contrast == "01POST - 01YR01")
pre_yr <- pairwise_results %>% filter(contrast == "00PRE - 01YR01")

t1 <- pre_post %>% select(-contrast) %>% gt() %>%tab_header(title = "Table 1A: Fuel Loads 00PRE vs 01POST") %>%cols_label(FuelCategory = "Fuel Category",
    estimate = "Difference",SE = "SE",df = "Den. df",t.ratio = "t value",p.value = "p-value") %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),locations = cells_body(rows = p.value < 0.1))

t2 <- post_yr %>%select(-contrast) %>%gt() %>%tab_header(title = "Table 1B: 01POST vs 01YR01") %>%cols_label(FuelCategory = "Fuel Category",
    estimate = "Difference",SE = "SE",df = "Den. df",t.ratio = "t value",p.value = "p-value") %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),locations = cells_body(rows = p.value < 0.1))

t3 <- pre_yr %>%select(-contrast) %>%gt() %>%tab_header(title = "Table 1C: 00PRE vs 01YR01") %>%cols_label(FuelCategory = "Fuel Category",
    estimate = "Difference",SE = "SE",df = "Den. df",t.ratio = "t value",p.value = "p-value") %>%
```

```{r}
  mutate(Type = recode(Type, Sub = "Substrate", Veg = "Vegetation"), Severity = as.integer(Severity)) %>% 
  mutate(Severity = case_when(Severity == 1 ~ "Heavily Burned", Severity == 2 ~ "Moderately Burned", Severity == 3 ~ "Lightly Burned", Severity == 4 ~ "Charred", Severity == 5 ~ "Unburned"))
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================

# Stats: linear mixed-effects model
fuels2 <- read.csv("2026 Annual Report Data/Clean/Fall24RX_fuels_report.csv") %>% select(-c(ThoHr_Snd, ThoHr_Rot))

#PERMANOVA
fuels_mat <- fuels2 %>% dplyr::select(-c(1:3))
fuels_mat <- sqrt(fuels_mat)
fuels_meta <- fuels2 %>% dplyr::select(2:3)
vegan::adonis2(fuels_mat ~ MonStatus, data = fuels_meta, strata = fuels_meta$Macroplot, method = "bray", permutations =999)
#significant (p = 0.002)

#Mixed Effects Model

fuels2$MonStatus <- factor(fuels2$MonStatus, levels = c("00PRE", "01POST", "01YR01"))

#log-transform
fuels2 <- fuels2 %>% mutate(OneHr = sqrt(OneHr), TenHr = sqrt(TenHr), HunHr = sqrt(HunHr), FineWood = sqrt(FineWood), TotalWood = sqrt(TotalWood), Duff = sqrt(Duff), Litter = sqrt(Litter), TotalAll = sqrt(TotalAll))
fuel_vars <- c("OneHr", "TenHr", "HunHr", "FineWood", "TotalWood", "Duff", "Litter", "TotalAll")

model <- lmer(TotalAll ~ MonStatus + (1 | Macroplot), data = fuels2)
anova(model)
emmeans(model, pairwise ~ MonStatus, adjust = "BH")


#Putting all pairwise results into a table

pairwise_results <- map_dfr(fuel_vars, function(var) {
  m <- lmer(as.formula(paste0(var, " ~ MonStatus + (1 | Macroplot)")), data = fuels2)
  em <- emmeans(m, pairwise ~ MonStatus, adjust = "BH", type = "response")
   as.data.frame(em$contrasts) %>%
    mutate(FuelCategory = var) %>%
    select(FuelCategory, contrast, estimate, SE, df, t.ratio, p.value)})

pairwise_results <- pairwise_results %>% mutate(estimate = round(estimate, 2),SE = round(SE, 2),t.ratio = round(t.ratio, 2),p.value = round(p.value, 3))
pre_post <- pairwise_results %>% filter(contrast == "00PRE - 01POST")
post_yr <- pairwise_results %>% filter(contrast == "01POST - 01YR01")
pre_yr <- pairwise_results %>% filter(contrast == "00PRE - 01YR01")

t1 <- pre_post %>% select(-contrast) %>% gt() %>%tab_header(title = "Table 1A: Fuel Loads 00PRE vs 01POST") %>%cols_label(FuelCategory = "Fuel Category",
    estimate = "Difference",SE = "SE",df = "Den. df",t.ratio = "t value",p.value = "p-value") %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),locations = cells_body(rows = p.value < 0.1))

t2 <- post_yr %>%select(-contrast) %>%gt() %>%tab_header(title = "Table 1B: 01POST vs 01YR01") %>%cols_label(FuelCategory = "Fuel Category",
    estimate = "Difference",SE = "SE",df = "Den. df",t.ratio = "t value",p.value = "p-value") %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),locations = cells_body(rows = p.value < 0.1))

t3 <- pre_yr %>%select(-contrast) %>%gt() %>%tab_header(title = "Table 1C: 00PRE vs 01YR01") %>%cols_label(FuelCategory = "Fuel Category",
    estimate = "Difference",SE = "SE",df = "Den. df",t.ratio = "t value",p.value = "p-value") %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),locations = cells_body(rows = p.value < 0.1))
```

```{r}
# 1. Functional groups
cover_stats <- cover %>% filter(FuncGroup != "Substrate") %>% group_by(Plot, Status2, FuncGroup) %>% summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% pivot_wider(names_from = FuncGroup, values_from = count, values_fill = 0)

adonis2(dist_matrix ~ Status2, data = cover_stats, permutations = 999)

# no significant difference: p = 0.211

cover_stats <- cover %>% filter(FuncGroup != "Substrate") %>% group_by(Plot, Status2, Native) %>% summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% pivot_wider(names_from = Native, values_from = count, values_fill = 0)
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================

# Stats: linear mixed-effects model
fuels2 <- read.csv("2026 Annual Report Data/Clean/Fall25RX_fuels_report.csv") %>% dplyr::select(-c(ThoHr_Snd, ThoHr_Rot))%>%   mutate(MonStatus = case_when(MonStatus %in% c("01PRE", "02PRE") ~ "PRE", MonStatus %in% c("03POST", "02POST") ~ "POST"))
pipo <- fuels2 %>% slice(c(1:2)) %>% mutate(MonStatus = "POST")
fuels2 <- rbind(fuels2, pipo)

bm <- fuels2 %>% filter(Plot == "PIPS_01" | Plot == "PIPS_02" | Plot == "PIPS_05")
hq <- fuels2 %>% filter(Plot == "PIPS_14" | Plot == "PIPO_27" | Plot == "PIPO_09")


#PERMANOVA - BM
fuels_mat <- bm %>% dplyr::select(-c(1:3))
fuels_mat <- sqrt(fuels_mat)
fuels_meta <- bm %>% dplyr::select(2:3)
vegan::adonis2(fuels_mat ~ MonStatus, data = fuels_meta, strata = fuels_meta$Plot, method = "bray", permutations =999)
#not significant (p = 0.25)

#PERMANOVA - HQ
fuels_mat <- hq %>% dplyr::select(-c(1:3))
fuels_mat <- sqrt(fuels_mat)
fuels_meta <- hq %>% dplyr::select(2:3)
vegan::adonis2(fuels_mat ~ MonStatus, data = fuels_meta, strata = fuels_meta$Plot, method = "bray", permutations =999)
#not significant (p = 1)

#PERMANOVA - both units
fuels_mat <- fuels2 %>% dplyr::select(-c(1:3))
fuels_mat <- sqrt(fuels_mat)
fuels_meta <- fuels2 %>% dplyr::select(2:3)
vegan::adonis2(fuels_mat ~ MonStatus, data = fuels_meta, strata = fuels_meta$Plot, method = "bray", permutations =999)
#not significant (p = 0.125)

# ==============================================================================
#Mixed Effects Model

fuels2$MonStatus <- factor(fuels2$MonStatus, levels = c("PRE", "POST"))
#log-transform
fuels2 <- fuels2 %>% mutate(OneHr = sqrt(OneHr), TenHr = sqrt(TenHr), HunHr = sqrt(HunHr), FineWood = sqrt(FineWood), TotalWood = sqrt(TotalWood), Duff = sqrt(Duff), Litter = sqrt(Litter), TotalAll = sqrt(TotalAll))
fuel_vars <- c("OneHr", "TenHr", "HunHr", "FineWood", "TotalWood", "Duff", "Litter", "TotalAll")

bm <- fuels2 %>% filter(Plot == "PIPS_01" | Plot == "PIPS_02" | Plot == "PIPS_05")
hq <- fuels2 %>% filter(Plot == "PIPS_14" | Plot == "PIPO_27" | Plot == "PIPO_09")



#Putting all pairwise results into a table - BM

pairwise_results <- map_dfr(fuel_vars, function(var) {
  m <- lmer(as.formula(paste0(var, " ~ MonStatus + (1 | Plot)")), data = bm)
  em <- emmeans(m, pairwise ~ MonStatus, adjust = "BH", type = "response")
   as.data.frame(em$contrasts) %>%
    mutate(FuelCategory = var) %>%
    dplyr::select(FuelCategory, contrast, estimate, SE, df, t.ratio, p.value)})

pairwise_results <- pairwise_results %>% mutate(estimate = round(estimate, 2),SE = round(SE, 2),t.ratio = round(t.ratio, 2),p.value = round(p.value, 3))

t1 <- pairwise_results %>% dplyr::select(-contrast) %>% gt() %>%tab_header(title = "Table 1A: Beaver Meadows Fuel Loads 0PRE vs POST") %>%cols_label(FuelCategory = "Fuel Category",
    estimate = "Difference",SE = "SE",df = "Den. df",t.ratio = "t value",p.value = "p-value") %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),locations = cells_body(rows = p.value < 0.1))


#Putting all pairwise results into a table - HQ

pairwise_results <- map_dfr(fuel_vars, function(var) {
  m <- lmer(as.formula(paste0(var, " ~ MonStatus + (1 | Plot)")), data = hq)
  em <- emmeans(m, pairwise ~ MonStatus, adjust = "BH", type = "response")
   as.data.frame(em$contrasts) %>%
    mutate(FuelCategory = var) %>%
    dplyr::select(FuelCategory, contrast, estimate, SE, df, t.ratio, p.value)})

pairwise_results <- pairwise_results %>% mutate(estimate = round(estimate, 2),SE = round(SE, 2),t.ratio = round(t.ratio, 2),p.value = round(p.value, 3))

t2 <- pairwise_results %>% dplyr::select(-contrast) %>% gt() %>%tab_header(title = "Table 1B: Headquarters Fuel Loads 0PRE vs POST") %>%cols_label(FuelCategory = "Fuel Category",
    estimate = "Difference",SE = "SE",df = "Den. df",t.ratio = "t value",p.value = "p-value") %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),locations = cells_body(rows = p.value < 0.1))
```

### 6. Thunder Mountain Fuels Project

Interpretation: 
- Basal area differs significantly by species and status where p <0.05. Tukey HSD indicates which species pair differ
- Cover differs among functional groups; trees dominate canopy cover, shrubs contribute intermediate understory cover
- shrub density varies significantly among species; plot-to-plot variation is captured in the mixed-effects model

```{r}
#I have 1 40m2 and 1 36m2 belts per plot, so 76m2, and 76m2 = 0.01879, so I need to divide the count per plot by .01878 to get count per acre
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(sf)
library(ggrepel)
library(dplyr)

# ---- Read Data ----
burn_units <- st_read("2026 Annual Report Data/maps/NPS_burn_units.shp", crs = 4269)
burn_units <- burn_units %>% filter(UNITNAME == "Rocky Mountain National Park")
plot_points <- st_read("2026 Annual Report Data/maps/plotpoints.shp")
plot_points <- st_transform(plot_points, 4269)
nps_bound <- st_read("2026 Annual Report Data/maps/NPSboundary.shp", crs = 4269) %>% 
  filter(UNIT_CODE == "ROMO")
trails <- st_read("2026 Annual Report Data/maps/ROMO_trails.shp") %>% st_transform(4269)
etmap <- st_read("2026 Annual Report Data/maps/EastTroublesome/20201104_1850_EastTroublesome_HeatPerimeter.shp", crs = 4269)

# ---- Filter and format points ----
plot_points <- plot_points %>%
  dplyr::select(c(Burn_Proje, Plot_Numbe, Latitude, Longitude, geometry)) %>%
  filter(Burn_Proje %in% c("Headquarters","Beaver Meadows","East Troublesome","Thunder Mountain","Eagle Cliff")) %>%
  mutate(Project = case_when(
    Burn_Proje == "East Troublesome" ~ "East Troublesome",
    Burn_Proje == "Eagle Cliff" ~ "Eagle Cliff",
    Burn_Proje == "Thunder Mountain" ~ "Thunder Mountain",
    Plot_Numbe %in% c("RAP_01","RAP_02","RAP_03","RAP_04","RAP_06","RAP_09","RAP_10") ~ "Headquarters Fall 2024",
    Plot_Numbe %in% c("RAP_13","RAP_14","RAP_15","RAP_16","PIPS_16","PIPS_08") ~ "Headquarters Spring 2025",
    Plot_Numbe %in% c("PIPO_09","PIPO_27","PIPS_14") ~ "Headquarters Fall 2025",
    Plot_Numbe %in% c("PIPS_01","PIPS_02","PIPS_05") ~ "Beaver Meadows Fall 2025",
    TRUE ~ "blank")) %>% filter(Project != "blank") %>%
  mutate(Plot_Numbe = iconv(Plot_Numbe, from="UTF-8", to="ASCII//TRANSLIT"),Project = iconv(Project, from="UTF-8", to="ASCII//TRANSLIT"))
# ---- Theme ----
theme_nps <- function() {
  theme_bw(base_family = "serif") +
    theme(
      text = element_text(color = "#333333", size = 14),
      plot.title = element_text(face="bold", size=18, hjust=0),
      axis.title = element_text(size=16),
      axis.text = element_text(size=13),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray85", linewidth=0.3),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color="black", fill=NA),
      legend.title = element_text(size=14),
      legend.text = element_text(size=12),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill="#6E6E6E", color="#2E2E2E"),
      strip.text = element_text(color="white", face="bold", size=14))}

nps_pal <- c("#556B2F","#8F9779","#A0522D","#CD853F","#DAA520","#8B4513", "#8B6508")

# ---- Main Map ----
main_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = nps_bound, fill = "#f5f3e7", color = "#333333") + geom_sf(data = trails, color = "#666666", size = 0.4) + 
  geom_sf(data = plot_points, aes(color = Project), size = 2) + labs(title = "2025 ROMO Plot Map") + 
  scale_color_manual(values = nps_pal) +theme_nps() +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.98, 0.02),legend.justification = c(1,0),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = scales::alpha("white", 0.8), color="#333333"))


# Formatting so ggdraw won't crash
# Make sure labels are ASCII only
plot_points$Plot_Numbe <- gsub("[^ -~]", "", plot_points$Plot_Numbe)
plot_points$Project <- gsub("[^ -~]", "", plot_points$Project)

# Split ET and ES
et <- plot_points %>% filter(Project == "East Troublesome")
es <- plot_points %>% filter(Project != "East Troublesome")

# Add coordinates for labeling
et_coords <- cbind(et, st_coordinates(et))
es_coords <- cbind(es, st_coordinates(es))

# Calculate safe nudges based on bbox
et_bbox <- st_bbox(et)
es_bbox <- st_bbox(es)

et_nudge_x <- 0.01 * (et_bbox["xmax"] - et_bbox["xmin"])
et_nudge_y <- -0.01 * (et_bbox["ymax"] - et_bbox["ymin"])

es_nudge_x <- 0.01 * (es_bbox["xmax"] - es_bbox["xmin"])
es_nudge_y <- -0.01 * (es_bbox["ymax"] - es_bbox["ymin"])

# ET inset (top left-ish)
inset_et <- ggplot() +geom_sf(data = nps_bound, fill = "#f5f3e7", color = "#333333") + geom_sf(data = etmap, fill = scales::alpha("#DAA520", 0.7))+
  geom_sf(data = trails, color = "#666666", size = 0.4)+ geom_sf(data = et, color = "#A0522D", size = 2) +
  geom_text_repel(data = et_coords,aes(x = X, y = Y, label = Plot_Numbe),size = 3,
    nudge_x = et_nudge_x,nudge_y = et_nudge_y,fontface = "bold",min.segment.length = 0) +
  coord_sf(xlim = et_bbox[c("xmin","xmax")],ylim = et_bbox[c("ymin","ymax")]) + labs(title = "East Troublesome Plots") +
  theme_nps() + theme(legend.position = "none",axis.text = element_blank(),axis.title = element_blank())

# ES inset (top right, larger)
# Get bbox
es_bbox <- st_bbox(es)
# Convert bbox to a polygon (sfc object)
es_poly <- st_as_sfc(es_bbox)
# Make sure it's the same CRS as burn_units
es_poly <- st_set_crs(es_poly, st_crs(burn_units))

# Turn off s2 for safe planar intersection (optional but often avoids errors)
sf_use_s2(FALSE)

# Intersect burn units with the bbox polygon
burn_units_crop <- st_intersection(burn_units, es_poly)

burn_units_crop <- burn_units_crop  %>% filter(BurnUnitNa %in% c("Beaver Meadows Block B", "Eagle Cliff", "Headquarters Block A", "Headquarters Block B", "Headquarters Block E", "Headquarters Block F","Headquarters Block G", "Headquarters Block H", "Headquarters Block I" ))
burn_units_crop <- burn_units_crop %>% mutate(BurnUnit = case_when(BurnUnitNa %in% c("Headquarters Block A", "Headquarters Block B", "Headquarters Block E", "Headquarters Block F") ~ "Headquarters Fall 2024", BurnUnitNa %in% c("Headquarters Block G", "Headquarters Block H") ~ "Headquarters Spring 2025", BurnUnitNa == "Eagle Cliff" ~ "Eagle Cliff", BurnUnitNa == "Beaver Meadows Block B" ~ "Beaver Meadows Fall 2025", BurnUnitNa == "Headquarters Block I" ~ "Headquarters Fall 2025"))




inset_es <- ggplot() +geom_sf(data = nps_bound, fill = "#f5f3e7", color = "#333333") +geom_sf(data = trails, color = "#666666", size = 0.4)+
  geom_sf(data = burn_units_crop, aes(fill = BurnUnit), alpha=0.5)+  
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#556B2F", "#8F9779","#CD853F","#DAA520","#8B4513"))+
  geom_sf(data = es, color = "black", size = 2) +geom_text_repel(data = es_coords,aes(x = X, y = Y, label = Plot_Numbe),
    size = 3,nudge_x = es_nudge_x,nudge_y = es_nudge_y,fontface = "bold",min.segment.length = 0) +coord_sf(xlim = es_bbox[c("xmin","xmax")],ylim = es_bbox[c("ymin","ymax")]) + labs(title = "East Side Plots") +
  theme_nps() + theme(axis.text = element_blank(),axis.title = element_blank(), legend.position = "none")

# Combine main map + insets
final_map <- ggdraw() +
  draw_plot(main_map, 0, 0, 1, 1) +
  draw_plot(inset_et, 0.15, 0.55, 0.35, 0.35) +   # ET inset closer to center
  draw_plot(inset_es, 0.55, 0.55, 0.42, 0.42) 

# Display
final_map
```
